title: Golden-Set Gate for a Prompt Change
signature: def gate_prompt_change(llm, new_prompt, golden, baseline, policy)
hints: Call the model exactly once per golden case, in list order, with [system = new_prompt, user = case input]. A model error is a failed case, not a crashed CI job.
A must-pass case regresses when it passed on the baseline and fails now. Averages can hide it, so check it on its own.
Compare drops in integers: block when 100 * (baseline_passes - new_passes) > max_drop_pp * n. Subtracting two float rates puts 0.8 - 0.7 just above 0.1.
Only slices with at least min_slice cases can block. Report the small ones anyway, with gated set to False.
